name: Voice Input
description: Use a global shortcut to type what you say into any app. Speech is recognized on this computer or by a server you choose.
about: Use a global shortcut to type what you say into whichever app you are using. On this computer you can choose Qwen3-ASR 1.7B or 0.6B. When you recognize speech on this computer, you download the selected model and run it with the included llama.cpp. You can instead send your speech to any OpenAI-compatible server you choose, such as OpenAI or one on your network. You can choose the language you speak and leave out filler words; on this computer Gode’s vocabulary also corrects names the model spells out. Dictation history and learned terms are stored on this computer. When you use a server, learned terms are also sent to it to help recognition.

polish.description: A model on this computer also leaves out words said twice, words such as “like” that carry no meaning, and what you take back when you correct yourself. It may change your wording, the text takes a moment longer to appear, and the model is about 1.3 GB.
removeFillers.description: Leaves out sounds such as “um” and “uh” said while thinking, and words said several times in a row by accident.
